description: COVID-19 ancestral strain seeded in China on 2020-01-01. Ground-truth values are confirmed-case counts as of 2020-01-30 from the JHU CSSE COVID-19 archive (https://github.com/CSSEGISandData/COVID-19), aggregated to country level.
reporting_fraction_note: Confirmed cases at day 30 are a small fraction of true infections during early-2020 surveillance ramp-up. Imperial College and CDC retrospectives place the case-to-infection ratio in the 5% to 15% range for January 2020. We deflate the simulator's projected infections by 0.10 before comparing to confirmed counts so the backtest is on like-for-like terms.
